description: This file contains platform-specific functions and configurations for OpenWrt in the mvebu/cortexa9 architecture, including image checks, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying for various device models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is compatible with the board by name, invoking legacy checks for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles device-specific firmware upgrade procedures based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration files based on the board name.
